title: Swapping Nodes In A Linked List
description: Swap the values of the k-th node from the beginning and the k-th node from the end of a linked list.
pseudocode:
1. p1 = head, p2 = head
2. for i = 1 to k-1: p1 = p1.next
3. first = p1, ptr = p1
4. while ptr.next != null: ptr = ptr.next, p2 = p2.next
5. temp = first.val, first.val = p2.val, p2.val = temp

steps.note: Initialize pointers p1 and p2 at the head.
Move p1 to the k-th node (index 1, value 2).
Move p2 and ptr until ptr reaches the end.
Swap values of first node (2) and second node (2).
